_comment: Example provision requests for testing and documentation

example_1_standard_partner.description: Standard external partner provisioning for Coca-Cola
example_1_standard_partner.expected_result: allowed — coca-cola.com is in team-cpg allowlist

example_2_internal_sharing.description: Internal sharing between Deloitte member firms
example_2_internal_sharing.expected_result: allowed — deloitte.ca is a globally allowed domain

example_3_restricted_partner.description: Restricted workspace for a financial services partner
example_3_restricted_partner.expected_result: allowed — jpmorgan.com is in team-finance allowlist

example_4_blocked_domain.description: Attempt to provision with a free email domain
example_4_blocked_domain.expected_result: denied — gmail.com is in the blocked domains list

example_5_multi_domain_violation.description: Attempt to mix two external partner domains
example_5_multi_domain_violation.expected_result: denied — single_partner_domain_required is true, and two external domains provided
